title: Build your own Agentic GTM: Part 1
subtitle: Your company brief, two account pages and a reusable skill.
source_note: Henry independently completed Part 1 with Claude Code for Datadog and Okta. His feedback drives this edition. Start with the prepared project, supply company context, then run one step at a time. Gil's four steps remain: skills, execution flow, target accounts, ten-account test. Each session has 90 guided minutes including a five-minute break and 30 minutes of individual help. Live outreach needs the attendee's own sender, current records, paid email validation and exact approval. Social, gifts, advertising and unattended operation are optional extensions. Private production records and credentials are excluded. Company-wide outcomes are separate from engine proof.
